status: NEW finite source-authoring record contracts; not runtime implementation

contracts.name: Ordinary cast and provider

requiredEvidence.identity: actual actor/world/castId/source spellId/exact mode/sourceVersion/class-provider grant and acquisition/repertoire history
requiredEvidence.time: declaration, precommit, commit, interrupt/resume, resolution timestamps and total ordering
requiredEvidence.legality: actual action/Reaction where authorized, body/components/focus, target/geometry/perception/line-of-effect and independent source constraints
requiredEvidence.funding: precommit RP/maxRP, Dissonance/Limit, last spell/repeat state, actual modifiers, independent material/charge/use entitlements, quoted/reserved/spent amounts
requiredEvidence.outcome: committed/countered/resolved/no-effect/end reasons plus real roll identity and generating DC/rank snapshot

contracts.boundary: A Boolean legal or a source-file citation is not itself evidence of an actual actor grant or completed cast.

contracts.name: Fate original observation

requiredEvidence.original: original noncopy spell cast and actual caster; completed/survived interruption state; exact authoritative operative mode/rank/ordinary activation
requiredEvidence.observation: observer, actual observation and identification method, time and within120-foot/line-of-effect facts at the observed event
requiredEvidence.lineage: original cast completion timestamp and any separate readied release, copy lineage, nondamage procedure review binding
requiredEvidence.selection: one exact original selected at outer commitment/preparation; age bound0..18 inclusive

contracts.boundary: Later recollection/history query, successful report or new ID does not create a direct original observation.

contracts.name: Fate nested transaction

requiredEvidence.parentChild: distinct linked outer/child cast/application IDs; copied source identity and temporary one-use permission
requiredEvidence.forecast: outer and child forecast based on mandatory outer transitions; actual independent preexisting entitlements and full fund reservation
requiredEvidence.commit: outer paid state then surviving child revalidation/repricing/commit; separate counter windows and chronological strain/history
requiredEvidence.hooks: ordinary outer hooks; child mandatory bookkeeping and prohibited duplicate proc/refund/action/copy branches
requiredEvidence.ready: preparation/freshness snapshot, held concentration, expiry, trigger/release, actual Reaction and unused reservation release

contracts.boundary: An unspent reservation release is not a refund. Parent resumption never rewrites a later actual cast history.

contracts.name: Shield event ledger

requiredEvidence.ward: source cast/caster/recipient/current application, creation, deadline, remaining0..2, suppression/termination state
requiredEvidence.occurrence: final target after actual retarget, one immediate-spell occurrence vs standalone attack/later tick; separate underlying damage roots
requiredEvidence.damageStage: direct or actual positive pre-mitigation share vs explicit post-defense skip branch; mitigation/prevention/transfer order
requiredEvidence.consumption: automatic once-per-occurrence/recipient mark before consequences; active covered group until finish, no selectable delayed spend
requiredEvidence.replacement: new lawful application replacement and retained source/custody history

contracts.boundary: An event-group key authorizes no invented attack/cast; do not merge damage roots or make transfer a hit.

contracts.name: Information query

requiredEvidence.query: actual spell/caster/declared scope/geometry/anchor/question where applicable and resolution time
requiredEvidence.facts: internal world fact IDs/authoritative versions, actual times or explicit imprecision, category and scope predicates
requiredEvidence.protection: actual source and applicable information/subject/school/rank/time scope; field/existence boundaries internal only
requiredEvidence.result: readable truthful or source-authorized masked fields, justified absence vs indeterminate, permitted recipient/channel
requiredEvidence.audience: public procedure separate from private fact/protection/membership records

contracts.boundary: Conditional test-world fixtures are allowed when labeled; they cannot authenticate a real campaign. No count/placeholder side-channel for protected existence.

contracts.name: Vision trance and streamed faction feed

requiredEvidence.vision: actual fixed related anchor/question, conscious stationary concentration interval, interruptions, normal completion-and-answer,30-day horizon
requiredEvidence.faction: exact established faction identity, nominated actual local member evaluated after payment, institution-wide current activities and fact updates
requiredEvidence.lifecycle: actual original60-second deadline and spell-specific interruption/suppression/caster/reference rules, no implied refresh

contracts.boundary: Do not unify stationary Vision concentration with nonconcentration Faction streaming or an independently attached Shield.

contracts.name: Alignment overlays

requiredEvidence.underlying: actual two defined mechanical axes and independent change history; absence/null/raw source preserved
requiredEvidence.suggestion: existing actual fixed changed-axis values, caster orientation snapshot, no-change rule, concentration/deadline and canonical identity
requiredEvidence.purge: actual paid source, WIS outcome/immunity, concentration/suppression/deadline/replacement, effectiveNeutral overlay
requiredEvidence.priority: AP-AS-01 target baseline exclusion and after-Suggestion evaluation; caster baseline remains its actual effective state

contracts.boundary: Never overwrite the saved base, inferNeutral from unknown, or turn effective alignment into moral/setting interpretation or a new acquisition receipt.

validation: Require actual referenced source/actor/world consistency and lawful order; reject missing controlling prerequisites, wrong target/owner/phase, duplicate commitments, negative/nonfinite quantities and out-of-range integer counters. Do not fabricate positive premises merely to satisfy the contract.
